turns.prompt: Design an original virtual gardener outfit using the woven-cloth reference for restrained rhythm. I want practical-looking layers that still feel welcoming on camera. Show A and B on matching front, back, and bent-arm sheets. The apron, pocket opening, and waist closure should visibly belong to the garment rather than float as decoration. Keep the patterned area away from the face and hands, and make each pocket opening readable against the surrounding fabric. I do not want the photographed textile copied or tiled across everything. Show a face-and-shoulder thumbnail and explain which practical construction ideas are visible, without claiming the illustrated costume has been worn or tested. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

Choose B for the apron-to-waist relation, not its extra straps. Keep A unchanged. Simplify straps near the elbow and move pattern emphasis to the lower apron, while preserving the apron's attachment, pocket positions, face, and shoulder width. Make the bent-arm view show how the sleeve meets the apron without trapping the forearm. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

The pockets are clearer, but the pattern now competes with their openings. Change only pattern spacing and edge contrast around the pocket openings; keep the accepted pattern motif, overall apron silhouette, and all pocket and closure positions. Do not add another layer or accessory to solve it. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.
